k:岳.mnemonic: A hill (丘) stacked on top of a mountain (山): the highest point of all, above everything around it. Peak (point, mountain).
k:岳.hint: Hill on top of a mountain.

k:較.mnemonic: Two cars (車) mingle (交) at the crossroads and stop side by side. Now you can see which is bigger and which is shinier. Contrast (compare).

k:慮.mnemonic: You catch sight of tiger stripes (虍) in the long grass. Stop and think (思) before you take another step. Prudence (consider, thought, concern).

k:稿.mnemonic: A tall (高) stack of paper made from grain (禾) straw sits on the writer's desk, every sheet covered in crossings-out. Draft (copy, manuscript, straw).

k:序.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广) at the theatre door, a child (子) steps out beforehand (予) to tell the crowd what the play will be about. Preface (beginning, order, precedence).

k:狂.mnemonic: A hound (犭) that believes it is king (王). It wears a paper crown and barks orders at the moon. Lunatic (insane, crazy, confuse).
k:狂.hint: Hound in a crown, barking orders.

k:診.mnemonic: The doctor in his hat (𠆢) strokes his whiskers (彡) and listens to your chest, and only then will he say (言) what is wrong with you. Checkup (seeing, diagnose, examine).

k:埋.mnemonic: Before you leave your hometown (里), you put your treasures in a box and cover it with soil (土) under the old tree. Bury (be filled up, embedded).

k:弥.mnemonic: Only a few (少) arrows are left for the bow (弓), so each one now matters more than the one before. All the more (increasingly).

k:怖.mnemonic: A white linen (布) sheet lifts off the bed and floats down the hallway at midnight. Your heartbeat (忄) thunders in your ears. Dreadful (be frightened, fearful).

k:斎.mnemonic: Before you may show (示) yourself at the altar, everything is adjusted (斉): robe straight, hands rinsed, mouth rinsed. Purification (worship, avoid).
k:斎.hint: Straightened and rinsed before the altar.

k:購.mnemonic: Pay your shellfish (貝) money up front, and a boy in a hood (冂) brings the paper straight (直) to your door every morning. Subscription (buy).

k:墓.mnemonic: At the dusk (暮) of a life, the body is laid to rest under the soil (土) and a stone is set on top. Grave (tomb).
k:墓.hint: Under the soil at life's end.

k:帳.mnemonic: A long (長) strip of cloth like a towel (巾), folded into pages, where the shopkeeper writes down every sale. Notebook (account book, album, curtain).

k:潜.mnemonic: The pearl divers exchange (替) places. One comes up for air and the other slips under the water left by the tsunami (氵), out of sight. Submerge (conceal, hide).

k:械.mnemonic: A device built from a tree (木), full of wooden gears that obey one commandment (戒) only: turn when cranked. Contraption (machine, instrument, mechanism).
k:械.hint: Wooden gears that obey the crank.

k:貫.mnemonic: Mother (母) drills a hole through each shellfish (貝) and runs one string through them all to make a necklace. Pierce (penetrate, brace).

k:姓.mnemonic: The woman (女) who gave you life (生) also gave you the family name you carry. Surname.
k:姓.hint: Name from the one who bore you.

k:懸.mnemonic: The lineage (系) hangs by a thread. Every eye (目) is on the heir's sickbed and every heart (心) is held in mid-air, waiting. State of suspension (hang, depend, consult).

k:汚.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) left three (三) layers of mud in the baby's cradle (勹). It will take a lot of scrubbing. Dirty (pollute, disgrace, defile).

k:忍.mnemonic: A sword (刀) blade rests on your heart (心), and you neither flinch nor make a sound. Endure (bear, put up with, conceal).
k:忍.hint: Blade on the chest, no flinch.

k:挑.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) beckon: come on, then. Race me across the frozen lake, bare legs (儿) among the icicles (冫). Challenge (contend for).
k:挑.hint: Beckoning to race on the ice.

k:貸.mnemonic: The leader (亻) hands over some shellfish (貝) money and hangs a tally on a peg (弋), to remember who must bring it back. Lend.
k:貸.hint: Money out, tally on the peg.

k:咲.mnemonic: A person (人) looks up, mouth (口) open in delight. Overnight the bare branches overhead have turned into a pink heaven (天). Blossom (bloom).

k:呂.mnemonic: Two bones, each shaped like a mouth (口), one above the other, joined by a short slide (ノ) of cord: two links of the column down your back. Backbone (spine).
k:呂.hint: Two bones linked in a column.

k:拒.mnemonic: A gigantic (巨) hand, fingers (扌) spread, is held up flat in front of your face. No entry. Repel (refuse, reject, decline).

k:繁.mnemonic: Every (毎) thread (糸) of the vine sprouts ten more. Strike (攵) it back with a stick and it only grows thicker. Luxuriant (thick, overgrown, frequency).

k:呉.mnemonic: A fish comes up holding a present in its mouth (口) and offers it to you with both fins (ハ) spread wide. Give (do something for, kingdom of Wu).

k:彩.mnemonic: A claw (爪) scratches the bark of a cedar (杉) and red sap wells up, which the painter dabs onto her picture. Coloring (paint, makeup).
k:彩.hint: Red sap dabbed on a picture.

k:徹.mnemonic: The teacher who helps bring up (育) the class does not stroll (彳) past a hard problem. She will strike (攵) the board with her chalk until the idea goes all the way through. Penetrate (clear, pierce, strike home).
k:徹.hint: Chalk rapping until it sinks in.
